claims.quote: L114, Pseudacanthicus cf. leopardus, is a loricariid collected mostly in the rio Negro basin in Brazil, particularly the rio Demini.
P. leopardus was described from the Rupununi River in Guyana, so the identity of this fish remains unconfirmed.
One of the most popular Pseudacanthicus is L114 which originates from the middle Rio Negro basin in Brazil.
The real P. leopardus originates from the border region of Brazil and Guyana.
